text:
sam_partnerships: OrionSupply just reported a partial outbound short for CNTR-ZY-221. APAC reserved pool for SKU RWD-200 (marketplace + two enterprise pilots) down ~36 units. Need quick options.

inventory-bot: ALERT: SKU RWD-200 | region: APAC | reserved: 100 | on_hand: 64 | missing: 36 | snapshot: 2026-03-21T14:00:00Z :warning:

nina_ops: Oof. Which customers are in the first commit window? Any launch tied to this?

sam_partnerships: Commit list from reservations:
```
Customer,Region,Reserved,CommitDate
AlphaApps,APAC,20,2026-03-26
HarborTech,APAC,16,2026-03-29
CloudPilot,APAC,12,2026-04-05
Others,APAC,52,2026-04-15
```
Missing 36 impacts AlphaApps + HarborTech.

rob_logistics: Contacting OrionSupply now. If short-pick, we have three mitigations: 1) air-LTL for 30 units ETA+3 days (cost +28%), 2) swap with EU pool RWD-200B (compatibility check), 3) prioritize AlphaApps shipment and split remaining. Need product + finance OK.

hao_product: Quick note: RWD-200B uses narrower attention kernel; small perf delta on long prompts. Acceptable for HarborTech non-critical workloads but AlphaApps uses low-latency use case. Swap only as last resort.

finance-bot: Budget check: one-off air-LTL up to +30% for urgent customer-critical approved by finance-ops provisional. Formal approval pending receipts.

nina_ops: Let's prioritize AlphaApps. Sam, can you reach out to their PM offering expedited air at our expense? Offer fallback swap for HarborTech if they accept perf note.

sam_partnerships: Reaching out to AlphaApps now. Draft message: "Hi — supplier short impacted your Dedicated commit. We can expedite shipment (ETA 3 days) or delay 5 days with SLA credit. Please confirm preference." Thoughts?

hao_product: Good. Add note about possible temporary cap on max_context to mitigate perf if we send mixed pool.

rob_logistics: OrionSupply replied: manifest short due to packing line QC; can release 18 units this vessel and remaining 18 on next vessel ETA 2026-04-02. Air-LTL available for 30 units by 2026-03-24.

sam_partnerships: AlphaApps replied: accept expedited air. HarborTech prefers swap if perf caveat is clear. I'll confirm HarborTech acceptance and then we book.

rob_logistics: Booking air-LTL for 30 units. Flight ref: AX-4412. Cost +27%.

inventory-bot: Reservation update: reserved:100 | on_hand:94 | in_transit_air:30 | pending_supplier:18 | snapshot:2026-03-21T15:10:00Z

sam_partnerships: Closing note: AlphaApps covered, HarborTech offered swap -> awaiting sign-off. Will update once HarborTech responds. Thanks team.
